description: Department of Local Government - Uva Province - Extending the Investigation Period Temporarily Suspended the Function of Chairman - Kandeketiya P.S.
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the suspension of a local government official (the Chairman of Kandeketiya Pradeshiya Sabha) and the appointment of a retired judicial officer to conduct an investigation. This falls under judicial/law enforcement matters, specifically involving disciplinary actions and investigations within local government administration, making it Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement).
